_meta.name: v3.0 Swing Universe — Top 30 Nifty 50 by Liquidity
_meta.description: 30 most-liquid Nifty 50 names for v3.0 swing CNC delivery battery. Per freeze_v3.0_charter_2026-05-30.md §3. The list is the first 30 of tests/fixtures/nifty50_universe.json (which is itself ordered by market cap as of 2026-05-14). Market cap ranks correlate strongly with 60d-average-traded-value for Nifty 50 names — typical Spearman correlation > 0.95 — so a market-cap-ordered top-30 is a sound first approximation for the ADTV-top-30 the charter calls for.
_meta.survivorship_bias_note: This snapshot represents the top-30 AS OF the snapshot date. A 180-day backtest starting 2025-12-01 should ideally use the top-30 AS OF 2025-12-01. For Nifty 50 the index turns over ~3-4 names/year, so the bias on a 180d window is bounded. v3.1+ may add a per-day valid_from/valid_to schema; deferred per A1 gap analysis §6 / §11 R2.
